messages.subject: gedit & R syntax
parts:
I'm trying to modify syntax highlight for R in gedit. I have tried modifying the theme file and copying it to /.gnome2/gtksourceview-2.0/styles, which should override the /usr/share/gtksourceview-2.0, but doesn't. Any suggestions?

lp,
Roman

messages.author: 44b3d223f72974f7
messages.subject: RE: [Rkoholiki] gedit & R syntax
parts:
Hi, Roman,

A cannot help you with gedit because I don’t know what is wrong with your procedure. However, you might try solving your problem from a different perspective. J People find using EMACS with R plug-in quite helpful (see http://www.stat.duke.edu/courses/Spring04/sta244/computing/R-ESS.html or ask google), however, I strongly recommend using Rkward (http://rkward.sourceforge.net/) under linux – I find it to be even nicer than TinnR… Indeed it is meant for KDE desktops but I run it on Ubuntu Gnome withouth any problems. I was quite happy with its hint function and code completition and useful tabs instead of a bunch of windows for every helpfile I opened. I know this is no answer to your question, but it might just help.

S(mej) se,

Luka
